title: riordan-poset-enumeration: construction, enumeration and analysis of Riordan posets
description: Header-only C++20 library and tools for Riordan posets (posets whose order relation is a binary Riordan matrix): enumeration, canonical forms, verified counts of Riordan posets up to n = 28, recognition, Toeplitz and exponential Riordan posets, and an exact decision procedure for infinite Riordan posets.
